name: Iucharba

attributes.attribute: a minor Irish divinity and one of the Sons of Tuireann

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Iucharba is an Irish divinity. He was one of the Sons of Tuireann. He had a small role and little separate from this brothers.
objective: Document Iucharba as a minor Irish divinity.
key_results: Record Iucharba as one of the Sons of Tuireann.
